# Ankuram Tuition Centre

## About
Ankuram Tuition Centre is a premium small-batch (3-5 students per batch) Maths and Physics tutoring centre in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, India. Founded and taught by Swastik Sahal with 13+ years of teaching experience.

## Curricula
CBSE, ICSE, IB MYP, IB DP, IGCSE, Cambridge A-Levels, Telangana State Board

## Subjects
Mathematics (all levels), Physics, Science

## Grades
6 through 12

## Teaching Approach
Diagnostic-first: every student begins with a diagnostic assessment to identify gaps. Small batches of 3-5 students ensure personalised attention. Same teacher every class.
